jobs.title: Project Site Security Manager
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 297859

Relocation Authorized: National - Single
Telework Type: Full-Time Office/Project
Work Location: Pecos, TX

Extraordinary Teams Building Inspiring Projects

Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place.

Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. We serve the Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security & Environmental; Energy; Mining & Metals, and the Manufacturing and Technology markets. Our services span from initial planning and investment, through start-up and operations.

Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report.

Project Overview

The rapid growth of AI and digitalization is fueling unprecedented demand for data centers that require large, reliable sources of energy. In response to this market trend, the Renewables & Clean Power (R&CP) team have signed an early works contract to build one of the largest gas fired power generation facilities in the U.S.

This project is of significant scale and complexity, and our team is helping the customer progress early-stage development, that would lead to the start of full EPC delivery this year.

The candidate will mobilize on a long-term (camp) assignment to Pecos, Texas. This position is contingent upon project award.

Job Summary

In this role, you will assist with coordinating security programs, physical security services, and emergency planning for the protection of the project and jobsite. You will participate in the development and implementation of security criteria and programs and procedures; provide functional guidance and direction to assigned security personnel and contractors; and monitor security activities and the performance of security services.

Major Responsibilities

Leads the project security program for the construction site, project offices and camp, supporting a large, complex, low-to-medium risk construction environment in a remote location. Establishes security objectives and performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and ensure program effectiveness.
Directs the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of security strategies, criteria, policies, and procedures for all project operations.
Oversees and administers contracted site security services, ensuring performance is measured against established KPI’s, contractual requirements, and project security standards.
Provides functional direction to assigned security personnel and coordinates activities with the contracted guard force service provider, without direct supervision of contractor personnel.
Monitors security operations, audits performance, and ensures performance against established KPIs, corporate requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable federal, state and local laws.
Develops and implements security awareness and training programs tailored to project workforce needs, including site-specific and role-based instruction.
Establishes and maintains effective relationships with local law enforcement, intelligence providers, and peer security professionals to support threat monitoring, situational awareness, incident response planning and coordinated response to security incidents, including crowd-related events, demonstrations, and access control disruptions.
Provides security support and coordination with project disciplines that include but are not limited to Labor/Industrial Relations, Human Resources, Transportation & Logistics, and ES&H to address overlapping risks, ensure consistent application of policies, and support safe and compliant project operations.

Education And Experience Requirements

Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 10-13 years of relevant experience or 14-17 years of relevant work experience

Required Knowledge And Skills

Formal, specialized training in security, criminal justice, military, or related disciplines.

jobs.description:
ACCIONA is a global company, leading in the development of regenerative infrastructure that creates a positive impact on society. Our workforce consists of more than 65,000 professionals, present in more than 40 countries across the five continents, all contributing in our mission to design a better planet. Are you a passionate individual who wants to make a difference, promote sustainable development, and find solutions to the biggest global challenges including climate change, overpopulation, and water scarcity? Come and join us in building the infrastructure our planet needs to achieve a sustainable future.

We have successfully delivered large infrastructure projects across Canada since 2001. Our leadership and expertise span the entire value chain from research and development through construction, operation and maintenance of projects. Currently involved in some of Canada’s largest infrastructure projects, ACCIONA delivers solutions that contribute to the economic and social progress of the communities in which it operates.
www.acciona.ca

ACCIONA is a global leader in sustainable infrastructure and renewable energy, delivering innovative, forward-thinking solutions in over 40 countries. We’re proud to be shaping some of the most complex and transformative infrastructure projects in North America.

In partnership with Metrolinx, ACCIONA is playing a key role in the design and construction of the Eglinton Crosstown West Extension (ECWE), a 9.2-kilometre westward addition to Toronto’s Line 5 light rail transit network. This major infrastructure project includes seven new stations and installation of rail and systems under a progressive design-build model.

Beyond its technical scope, the ECWE project represents a significant investment in sustainable urban mobility, expected to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 5,800 tonnes annually and eliminate over 6.5 million vehicle trips each year when combined with the full Line 5.

This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team on a complex, high-value project that supports long-term regional growth and environmental sustainability. If you're ready to make a meaningful impact and advance your career with a global infrastructure leader, we encourage you to apply and grow with us.

The Construction Security Manager is responsible for managing the construction security program for the Eglinton Crosstown West Extension Project. The role supports the Chief Security Officer by implementing the Construction Security Master Plan, coordinating construction site security operations, managing security-related contractors, overseeing physical security systems, maintaining security training compliance, and supporting the identification and mitigation of security risks across the project.

The Security Manager acts as the primary operational security lead for construction security matters and works closely with site construction teams, security guards, systems contractors, emergency services, project management, safety teams, subcontractors, and relevant public-sector stakeholders.

Job Description

Construction Security Program Management

Implement the Construction Security Plan across project offices, construction sites, laydown areas, storage locations, temporary facilities, and other project-controlled areas.
Support the Chief Security Officer in developing, updating, and maintaining construction security policies, procedures, plans, post orders, and related documentation.
Ensure that construction security practices are aligned with project requirements, contract obligations, applicable laws, client expectations, and recognized security practices.
Provide security advice to project leadership, construction managers, site superintendents, and project stakeholders.

Construction Site Security Coordination

Liaise with construction teams, contractors project coordinators and schedulers, safety representatives and jurisdiction officials to ensure smooth, supportive security operations.
Coordinate security coverage for construction sites, laydown areas, project offices, high-risk activities, deliveries, material storage, and special events.
Review and support the development of site-specific security procedures, post orders, patrol routes, access control processes, and incident escalation protocols.
Conduct site visits to assess security performance, identify gaps, review guard deployment, and confirm implementation of security controls.
Support the management of site access control, visitor management, vehicle access, deliveries, gate operations, fencing, hoarding, lighting, CCTV coverage, intrusion detection, and other construction security measures.

Security Risk Assessments

Conduct and update construction security risk assessments for project sites, facilities, activities, and changing construction conditions.
Identify threats, vulnerabilities, operational risks, and security control gaps affecting project personnel, assets, materials, equipment, public interfaces, and construction activities.
Develop practical mitigation recommendations and track implementation of approved security measures.
Reassess risks as site conditions evolve, including during demolition, excavation, major deliveries, utility works, system installations, high-value material storage, and transitions between construction phases.
Maintain a risk register or other tracking mechanism for security risks, mitigations, and outstanding actions.

Physical Security Systems Oversight

Oversee the implementation and operation of physical security systems across the project.
Provide direction to the Construction Security Systems Administrator regarding access control, reporting, records management, system administration, and security system support.
Coordinate with security systems vendors, IT, communications teams, construction teams, and project stakeholders regarding system installation, testing, troubleshooting, maintenance, and performance.
Ensure that access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, gate controls, intercoms, alarms, lighting, and related systems are appropriate for project needs and site risk conditions.
Review system reports, incident records, alarm activity, access data, and other information to identify trends, issues, or required corrective actions.

Security Training and Compliance

Track and manage security training compliance across the project.
Ensure that required personnel complete applicable security training, site access training, awareness briefings, orientation requirements, and any project-specific security modules.
Coordinate with training, safety, HR, subcontractor management, and site teams to confirm training completion before access is granted where applicable.
Maintain or oversee records of security training completion, compliance status, overdue training, and corrective actions.
Support the development and delivery of security awareness materials, toolbox talks, briefings, bulletins, and incident lessons learned.

Emergency Services and Incident Management

Liaise with police, fire, emergency medical services, municipal authorities, transit security stakeholders, and other emergency response partners as required.
Support incident response for theft, vandalism, trespassing, protest activity, workplace violence, unauthorized access, suspicious activity, security breaches, emergency events, or other project-related security incidents.
Provide after-hours availability for urgent incidents, emergency coordination, and escalation support.
Ensure incidents are documented, investigated, escalated, and closed out in accordance with project procedures.
Review incident trends and recommend corrective actions to reduce recurrence.

Contractor and Contract Management

Manage responsibilities related to security guarding, security systems, and other security-related contracts.
Monitor contractor performance against contract requirements, service levels, post orders, project procedures, deliverables, and key performance indicators.
Review guard force deployment, staffing levels, schedules, reports, incident documentation, patrol records, and service quality.
Coordinate with procurement, commercial, and contract management teams on security contractor performance, scope changes, deficiencies, invoices, claims, and corrective actions.
Support the development of scopes of work, technical requirements, service expectations, and evaluation criteria for new or modified security contracts.

Reporting and Stakeholder Communication

Provide regular updates to the Chief Security Officer on security risks, incidents, site conditions, contractor performance, training compliance, and implementation of the Construction Security Master Plan.
Prepare reports, briefing notes, meeting materials, dashboards, and action trackers related to construction security.
Participate in project meetings, construction coordination meetings, risk meetings, emergency planning meetings, and stakeholder coordination forums.
Maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders while protecting confidential and security-sensitive information.

Required Skills And Competencies

3 + years of experience managing security operations in a construction, infrastructure, transit, public-sector, industrial, commercial, or multi-site environment, or alternative equivalent.
College Diploma or University degree in security management, criminology, law enforcement, emergency management, risk management, public safety, or a related field is preferred.
Experience coordinating guard services, access control, CCTV, physical security systems, incident response, and site security procedures.
Experience conducting or supporting security risk assessments.
Experience managing contractors, service providers, performance requirements, or security-related scopes of work.
Strong understanding of construction site operations, project delivery environments, access control, perimeter security, incident management, and emergency coordination.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to prepare reports, procedures, risk assessments, briefings, and action plans.
Ability to work with senior leadership, construction teams, subcontractors, emergency services, and external stakeholders.
Security certification, law enforcement, military, emergency management, infrastructure security, or transit security experience is an asset.

Core Competencies

Security leadership and operational judgment.
Risk assessment and mitigation.
Contractor and vendor management.
Incident response and escalation.
Stakeholder coordination.
Physical security systems oversight.
Training compliance management.
Documentation and reporting.
Ability to operate in a complex construction project environment.
Availability and responsiveness during urgent incidents.

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Stripe Security team is dedicated to improving the security of Stripe and its users. Our users trust us with some of their most sensitive information, and we make security a first-class consideration in everything we do. Security concerns are ever-evolving, creating an extremely dynamic environment for the Security team.

The Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (SGRC) team at Stripe provides security governance, risk management, and compliance capabilities to allow Stripe to make strategic security decisions, measure our risk and control posture, and represent Stripe Security to internal and external entities. The successful operation of our organization accelerates Stripe by optimizing the communication and expectations of our security program.

What you’ll do

We're looking for a Security GRC Program Manager with deep expertise in security compliance to serve as the primary interface between Stripe's Security organization and external auditors, regulators, and compliance stakeholders. In this role, you'll represent the Security team in audit engagements, articulate how Stripe's security controls are designed and how they operate, and ensure that compliance obligations across a complex global regulatory landscape are met with consistency and rigor.

In this role, you will act as a proxy between external entities like regulators and auditors, and our internal security teams, ensuring consistency in compliance responses and helping maintain a lean and effective compliance program. The ideal candidate is adaptable and finds structure in an evolving and maturing organization.

Responsibilities

Act as an information security subject matter expert during cross-functional audit engagements, representing the Security team in walkthrough meetings with auditors and regulators
Serve as the internal liaison (proxy) between and the Security organization to ensure audits are managed effectively and consistently
Create and maintain a central repository of audit evidence artifacts required for compliance with SOC 2, PCI DSS, SOX, and other global regulatory standards
Perform security risk and control assessments against common frameworks to ensure compliance with Stripe's Information Security Policy and Standards and applicable regulations (e.g., ISO 2700x, PCI DSS, SOX, NIST, COBIT)
Support control owners with guidance on security control design and redesign to ensure continued compliance and effectiveness
Facilitate security compliance support for Stripe's legal entities with regulatory obligations, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to track and report on control remediation efforts
Support broader GRC team program initiatives, including policy writing, security awareness training, and third-party security risk assessments

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

Subject matter expert in information security frameworks, practices, policies, standards, and procedures (e.g., NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/2, or equivalent)
6+ years of experience in Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance or Technology Compliance roles with a strong understanding of audit processes
Exposure to global regulatory requirements (e.g., DORA, FFIEC, EBA, NYDFS) and experience integrating them into compliance programs
Experience conducting security audits and supporting compliance across complex, overlapping regulatory frameworks
Strong program management skills with proficiency in coordinating security assessments and managing multiple stakeholder engagements across time zones
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build relationships at all levels and translate technical security concepts for auditors, regulators, and executive audiences

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $161,300 - $241,900. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Inspect Assurance Reports: Review and analyze independent assurance artifacts, including SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001 certifications, PCI DSS certifications, and related evidence, to validate control design and operating effectiveness.
Evaluate and Communicate Risk: Consolidate, interpret, and communicate cybersecurity risk metrics, trends, and findings to operational stakeholders and executive leadership.
Collaborate with Risk Partners: Partner with internal business, security, and risk teams to support informed third-party risk decisions and remediation efforts.
Support Continuous Improvement: Support continuous improvement of third-party risk processes, methodologies, and reporting practices.

Join our dynamic team to innovate and drive technology advancements, contributing to significant business growth and client success.

As a Technical Project Manager III in Commercial & Investment Bank - Securities Service Technology Project Execution team, you will help lead complex technology projects and programs that promote business goals and create value for clients, employees, and stakeholders. Applying a broad knowledge of technical principles, practices, and theories is essential to developing innovative solutions, along with leveraging analytical reasoning and adaptability skills to navigate through ambiguity and change. Your strong communication abilities will enable you to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and manage stakeholder relationships, ensuring alignment on project objectives and governance. By optimizing resources and managing risks, you will contribute to the successful delivery of high-impact projects that shape the future of the firm.

As a member of Securities Service Technology Project Execution team, you will execute projects on modernization and AWS cloud adoption. You will work with application development, Global Technology Infrastructure team, SRE / Production Management, Information Security Management, Engineer & Architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver on project requirements.

Job Responsibilities

Develop and execute end-to-end project plans that translate technical and operational objectives into clear scope, milestones, resourcing, and timelines.
Drive delivery across multiple concurrent projects, prioritizing work and unblocking teams to achieve measurable outcomes.
Identify and mitigate delivery, technology, and operational risks by implementing actionable risk management strategies.
Maintain a portfolio of projects and operational risk metrics, including key risk indicators aligned to cybersecurity, vulnerability, recovery, resiliency, and capacity.
Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate project planning and risk synthesis (e.g., drafting plans, RAID, and status narratives), validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity requirements.
Promotes reuse-first, AI-assisted practices for project governance artifacts and reporting, ensuring human review and alignment to delivery standards.
Monitor dashboards and reporting to surface trends, escalate issues, and drive corrective actions with partner teams.
Writes clear, evidence-based investigations and status updates that support governance and monthly leadership reviews.
Partners with application development, infrastructure, site reliability and production management, and information security to deliver infrastructure and application requirements.
Facilitates modernization efforts that improve how applications are designed, managed, and operated, including cloud adoption initiatives.
Tracks project costs and progress for hardware and software upgrades, ensuring transparency of delivery and spend.
Influences stakeholders and decision makers to resolve trade-offs, adapt plans, and maintain alignment to goals and controls.
Supports evaluation of relevant platforms, tools, and vendor products to enable effective implementation decisions.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

3+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in technical program or project management leading complex technology projects.
Demonstrated ability to lead through the full project lifecycle, including adapting to change and influencing decision makers.
Proven stakeholder management skills, with a track record of building productive working relationships across teams.
Strong technical fluency, with familiarity in relevant platforms, software tools, and technologies used by engineering and infrastructure teams such as M365, Jira, Confluence, Verum, and ServiceNow.
Experience identifying, tracking, and mitigating project risks and delivery roadblocks.
Experience developing and maintaining project plans, including scope, timelines, and resource coordination.
Ability to manage multiple priorities with strong organization, communication, and follow-through.
Experience producing clear project reporting, including status updates and written investigations.
Experience working in the Technology industry, or software engineering
Ability to review and validate AI-assisted plans, risks, and recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and following data handling expectations.
Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support technical program management workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Experience managing operational risk controls and resiliency-related initiatives (for example, recovery, vulnerability, and capacity measures).
Financial services experience with comfort operating in a complex, highly governed environment.
Experience partnering with global teams in a global delivery environment.

About Us

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

JPMorgan Chase & Co. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Veterans

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

Convergint is looking for a full-time, enthusiastic, results driven and forward-thinking Project Manager to join our amazing culture. In this role, you will be responsible for all aspects of assigned projects, including planning, scheduling, directing, application engineering, budgeting and procurement, as well as managing field installation, start-up, and close out of assigned projects. Ensures projects are effectively executed within budgeted cost, time schedules and ensure positive cash flow. In addition, position is key interface with the customer and responsible for maximizing customer satisfaction, safety, and quality assurance on all assigned projects. As a Project Manager, you are a part of a dynamic team that allows you to grow as Convergint grows.

For information about how we use your personal information, please see our Colleague & Applicant Privacy Notice, available on convergint.com/careers.

Who You Are

You have a passion for providing world-class service to customers, colleagues and communities. You are a person of integrity with a commitment to growth, accountability and delivering results. You want to join an organization with a positive culture that embraces equal opportunity and allows everyone to be the best version of themselves at work and home. You want to grow with us and deliver results as an exceptional Project Manager.

Who We Are

With 20-years of proven growth and exceptional performance, our mission is to be our customer’s best service provider. We realize the importance of diversity in achieving that goal. Our company was built upon a solid foundation of 10 Values and Beliefs which drive our unmatched culture, making us the #1 global, serviced-based systems integrator in the industry. We take great pride in protecting the lives and assets of our customers and their communities with the solutions we provide.

What you’ll do with “Our Training and Your Experience”

Convergint's greatest strength is our people! Every colleague is encouraged to participate in our Recruit Awesome People program, helping us grow Convergint by promoting our colleague-first culture and referring top talent to the Talent Acquisition Team and hiring managers.
Manages many aspects of assigned projects (typically valued up to $1M) from award through completion of project, including: overall site management of project(s) for successful and timely completion within budget.. Acts as “our customer’s best service provider” at all times thereby ensuring Convergint is the customer’s first choice for service.
Identifies potential project risks and develops/implements strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines.
Proactively communicates project schedules, project change proposals and related project activities on a regular basis with customer and seek to continuously improve customer satisfaction.
Manages the procurement (including selection) of materials, supplies, services and controls necessary for timely and cost effective completion of project within budget.
Establish project milestones and analyze costs; Exposure to financial systems to review actual vs. estimated job cost and to provide timely and accurate project cost reports; identify reasons for low job site productivity and determine impact on the project; adjusts or corrects project plan and/or project cost estimates as necessary to meet financial goals.
Manage the execution and review of all scope of work, terms and conditions in customer contracts including cost control, delivery fulfillment, quality control standards, quality of service and other customer requirements as they arise.
Responsible for management of direct reports, if applicable. Manages subcontractor selection process and work.
Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested or required.

Project management experience in a technical environment (building automation systems, fire alarm systems, electronic security systems and AV systems).
Coaching, mentoring, and staff development skills; solid leadership orientation – Actively seeks ways in which to act as a role model, guide, develop and mentor others within the organization.
Team leadership, team building and facilitation skills.
Shows initiative – engages in proactive behavior and looks for opportunities.
Adaptable – responds effectively to changes in situation or information; ability to influence others and build consensus using strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
Strong analytical skills necessary to resolve problems and look for solutions; solid conflict resolution skills.
Financial analytical skills including cost control.
Basic ability to facilitate a collaborative working environment for customers and team members.
Basic Microsoft Outlook, Project, Excel, Word and Power Point skills.
Basic knowledge and understanding of IT networking principles.
Must have knowledge of Security Systems and Access Control

Associates degree in Engineering or related field

Program and Project Manager

The Opportunity:

Perform critical program and project management support to our clients in the Army. Serve as the project lead responsible for overseeing, coordinating, and enabling the research, development, test, evaluation, and delivery of ground vehicle electronics and architecture solutions. Establish program and project rhythms, execution discipline, and stakeholder alignment across a portfolio spanning vehicle survivability, embedded software, and systems integration efforts. Perform technical reviews to establish and control baselines and help drive requirements development. Perform regular risk assessments and track and document cost, schedule, and performance. Perform stakeholder management activities to streamline processes, stabilize program execution, and foster collaboration between Government leadership, the Booz Allen delivery team, and internal and external organizations.

You Have:

15+ years of experience with program or project management within Army, ground vehicle, C5ISR, or embedded systems domains
Experience operating with urgency within a fast-moving, relationship-critical environment
Experience leading development, test, evaluation, or integration activities for ground vehicle systems, electronics, software, and technologies
Experience working with multifunctional teams of engineers across product managers, mission systems, vehicle electronics, computing architecture, or embedded software
Experience developing and managing cost, schedule, performance, and risk metrics for Army or DoW projects
Knowledge of the Army acquisition lifecycle
Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
Bachelor’s degree

Nice If You Have:

20+ years of experience with program management within Army, ground vehicle, C5ISR, or embedded systems domains
Secret clearance
Master’s degree
Program Management Professional (PMP), Army Acquisition Certified Professional, or other industry certification

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

As a fast-scaling company with offices in Brussels, Freiburg, Munich, Washington and Toulouse, our multidisciplinary team of engineers, scientists, and strategists is building the future of space-based Earth observation

Program Manager
to lead the execution of some of constellr's most strategic government programmes.

Acting as the primary interface between customers, consortium partners and internal engineering teams, you will ensure that contractual commitments, technical developments and commercial objectives remain fully aligned.

SpAItial is pioneering Physically-grounded World Models, a new AI paradigm designed to generate and reason about the appearance and physics of real and imagined environments. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the geometry of our world, and redefining how industries from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema create and interact with 3D environments.

You will own the recurring operations of the business, such as the monthly finance cycle, payroll, onboarding, vendors, filings, reporting, etc. You will work directly with our COO to facilitate smooth business ops and form the backbone of our company.

We are looking for someone diligent with attention to detail. Someone who keeps lists, who schedules the recurring thing the first time they see it, who notices that a deadline collides with a bank holiday before anyone else does. If you find satisfaction in a well-run cadence and a clean inbox, this role will suit you. It is hands-on, high-trust, and it will give you unusual visibility into how a frontier AI company gets built.

Responsibilities

Finance cycle with our accountants (reconciliations, management accounts, expenses, invoicing) and keep cash, burn, runway, and budget current and trustworthy.
People operations. Own payroll, onboarding, contracts, benefits, and employee documentation, and make sure a new joiner's first two weeks are excellent.
Advisors and compliance. Coordinate our payroll providers, pension, healthcare, banks, insurers, and legal counsel and keep the company in good standing across filings, VAT, statutory obligations, and insurance.
Vendors and spend. Own vendor relationships, contracts, and renewals, including significant compute and infrastructure commitments.
Workplace. Own our London office as a place people want to be, including management of space, equipment, suppliers, and support team events that make every day in the office worth it.
Process. Turn founder-led, manual workflows into documented processes that run without anyone remembering to run them.
Reporting. Prepare inputs for board materials, investor updates, and reporting packs, and work with our German colleagues and suppliers to keep things aligned

4+ years in operations, business operations, finance operations, or a similar role, including time in a startup or fast-moving technology company.
At least one role held long enough to live with the systems you built and fix them when they broke.
Exceptional diligence. You keep lists, you trust your system more than your memory, and you close things out, including the tedious ones.
Numerate and comfortable in spreadsheets, with the judgment to know when a figure looks wrong.
Genuinely AI-native. You already use these tools daily and reach for them first when work repeats.

Experience as the ops person at a company between 15 and 60 people.
Exposure to venture-backed company operations: fundraising processes, board reporting, cap table administration.
Experience working across multiple entities, currencies, or employment systems, particularly UK and Germany.
Familiarity with Xero, payroll platforms, HRIS (Personio, Bob) and expense tools, Carta, Notion, or Google Workspace.
Real interest in AI, machine learning, computer vision, 3D technology, or deep tech.

London & South

At BaxterStorey, we believe great hospitality is powered by brilliant people and the smart, reliable technology that supports them every day.

We're looking for a Tech Projects Implementation Manager
to support the delivery of technology workstreams across BaxterStorey's mobilisation, refurbishment and transformation projects throughout London and the South. You'll play a key role in bringing clarity to complex projects, ensuring technology requirements, infrastructure dependencies and operational needs are considered from concept through to handover.

Job Description

What You’ll Do

Lead the delivery and physical implementation of technology workstreams across BaxterStorey's mobilisation, refurbishment and transformation projects.
Act as the technology lead for BaxterStorey sales bids, ensuring technology solutions are operationally practical, commercially viable and fully integrated into mobilisation and implementation plans.
Conduct comprehensive technology audits and site assessments to understand operational requirements, infrastructure readiness, power and data requirements, equipment locations and user needs.
Develop clear technology scopes, technical briefs and implementation plans that support project approval, budgeting and successful delivery.
Coordinate the implementation of EPOS systems, digital ordering platforms, payment solutions, screens, kiosks and other approved hospitality technology solutions.
Act as the link between Projects, Operations, IT, suppliers, contractors and client stakeholders, ensuring technology requirements are understood and integrated into wider project plans.
Manage project plans, timelines, actions and technical activities, ensuring milestones, dependencies and go-live dates are achieved.
Maintain a solutions catalogue in partnership with the Central Technology Team, detailing use cases, infrastructure requirements, lead times, indicative costs and implementation considerations.
Identify and manage implementation risks, site constraints and infrastructure dependencies, escalating issues and driving resolutions before they impact project delivery.
Coordinate supplier activity, site installations, testing, commissioning and snagging activities to ensure technology is delivered to the required standard.
Support mobilisation and refurbishment projects by providing technology expertise during design reviews, build phases, pre-opening activities and operational readiness checks.
Build and lead a network of technology champions and super-users to maximise adoption and ensure solutions deliver operational and commercial value.
Facilitate regular project reviews, providing clear updates on progress, risks, decisions and actions to stakeholders.
Produce clear documentation, including technology scopes, implementation plans, risk registers, handover packs and post-implementation reviews.
Ensure effective handover into Operations, including training coordination, user readiness and support arrangements following go-live.
Capture lessons learned and continuously improve the way technology is scoped, implemented and embedded within BaxterStorey projects.
Support ad‑hoc digital improvement projects that enhance efficiency, consistency and the overall experience for our teams and clients.

Experience supporting or managing technology projects, ideally within hospitality, retail or a multi‑site operational environment.
Previous operational experience within the hospitality sector.
Practical understanding of EPOS systems, digital ordering tools or other hospitality technology platforms.
Strong organisational skills and confidence coordinating multiple workstreams at the same time.
A collaborative, people‑focused approach, with the ability to build effective working relationships across diverse teams.
Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail into operationally relevant language.
A practical understanding of structured project delivery and the realities of live service environments.
Good commercial awareness, with an appreciation of budgets, costs and operational impacts.
A proactive mindset, with a willingness to roll sleeves up and support where needed.
Flexibility to travel to client sites as required.

At BaxterStorey, food isn’t just fuel - it’s an experience. You’ll be joining a business that genuinely cares about people, creativity and doing things the right way.

This role offers exposure across the business, the chance to work on exciting mobilisations and refresh projects, and the opportunity to play a meaningful part in how our sites are launched and evolved. You’ll be supported, trusted and encouraged to grow, while maintaining a healthy work‑life balance.

Advanced Drainage Systems is a leading manufacturer of stormwater and onsite septic wastewater solutions, committed to sustainability and innovation. With a vast manufacturing and distribution network, we deliver high-quality products across multiple industries while recycling over half a billion pounds of plastic annually. At ADS, we foster a culture where diverse perspectives drive better ideas, ensuring every employee feels valued, heard, and empowered to make an impact.

Responsibilities

The Senior Procurement Analyst is responsible for transforming complex data into actionable business insights that support strategic decision-making, operational excellence, and long-term business growth. This role partners closely with Procurement and cross-functional stakeholders to modernize business processes, develop analytics and reporting solutions, automate manual activities, and advance the organization's data and analytics capabilities. The ideal candidate is an analytical problem solver with strong technical aptitude, excellent communication skills, and a passion for continuous improvement and innovation.

Primary Job Responsibilities

Develop and maintain a multi-year procurement data and analytics roadmap aligned with business strategy and organizational objectives.
Partner with Procurement and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for process improvement, data transformation, automation, and operational efficiency.
Design and implement scalable data integration solutions that connect business processes, systems, and external data sources while supporting future enterprise system initiatives.
Develop reporting, dashboards, forecasting models, and self-service analytics tools that provide meaningful business insights and performance visibility.
Translate complex business challenges into analytical frameworks, actionable recommendations, and measurable outcomes.
Evaluate emerging technologies, analytics platforms, artificial intelligence, and machine learning capabilities to enhance decision-making and business performance.
Establish and support scalable data governance, reporting standards, and integration processes that can be leveraged across future acquisitions and enterprise growth initiatives.
Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive collaboration, execute strategic initiatives, and achieve business objectives.
Lead continuous improvement efforts by reducing manual processes, standardizing workflows, and implementing automated solutions.
Communicate findings, recommendations, and project outcomes effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.

Job Skills

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities with the ability to transform data into business insights.
Proficiency with data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, and visualization tools.
Strong organizational, project management, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across diverse teams and stakeholder groups.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence and build consensus.
Customer-focused mindset with strong relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills.
Demonstrated leadership, initiative, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Eagerness to learn new technologies, processes, and analytical methodologies.

Educational Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
Advanced technical training or certifications in analytics, business intelligence, or data management are a plus.

Preferred Experience

3+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or a related analytical role.
Experience utilizing tools such as Python, SQL, Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Query, or similar technologies.
Strong Microsoft Excel and broader Microsoft Office proficiency.
Experience supporting procurement, supply chain, operations, or business management functions preferred.
Proven experience developing dashboards, reports, data models, and process automation solutions.
Demonstrated ability to manage internal and external stakeholders in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.
Experience driving data governance, systems integration, or enterprise transformation initiatives is a plus.
Experience evaluating and applying emerging technologies, including AI-enabled analytics solutions, preferred.

Physical Requirements

Ability to travel up to 5% as business needs require.

Job Title: Information Security Analyst
(hybrid- onsite Monday- Thursday)

Location:
US-GA-Atlanta (Sandy Springs)

FLSA
: Exempt

Job Overview
:

Safeguard is seeking an Information Security Analyst to support the day-to-day operation and improvement of our security program. This is a hands-on, operationally focused role: you will triage and resolve security requests, serve as a first responder for potential security incidents, administer our physical access control and surveillance systems, and operate the platforms that protect our endpoints, network traffic, data, and infrastructure.

The role sits at the intersection of several teams. You will partner regularly with infrastructure, application, and end-user support groups to make sure security requirements are understood, implemented, and sustained — not just documented. Success in this position looks like fewer recurring issues, cleaner detection signal, faster response, and stronger working relationships with the teams whose systems you help secure.

Safeguard is an AI-first organization. We expect our security team to use AI assistants as part of their normal working rhythm: summarizing and correlating log data, drafting and refining detection logic, accelerating investigation write-ups, researching threats and techniques, and automating repetitive queue work. You do not need to be an AI specialist, but you should be genuinely comfortable working alongside these tools and interested in getting better at it.

Job Responsibilities:

Own an assigned queue of security requests, access reviews, escalations, and remediation tasks, driving each to documented completion within defined service levels.
Maintain clear, auditable records of actions taken, decisions made, and evidence collected.
Identify recurring ticket drivers and recommend automation, configuration changes, or process improvements to reduce them.
Serve as first-level responder for security alerts and reported events: validate, triage, contain where appropriate, and escalate to senior staff with a clear written handoff.
Perform initial investigation using endpoint, network, identity, and log telemetry to determine scope and impact.
Contribute to post-incident documentation, root cause analysis, and follow-up remediation tracking.
Participate in an on-call or after-hours escalation rotation as required.
Operate and maintain the organization's core security tooling, including:
Endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR) — policy configuration, agent health and coverage, detection triage.
Cloud-delivered secure web and network access (SSE/SWG/ZTNA) — policy management, traffic inspection rules, and access enforcement.
Data security and access governance — monitoring sensitive data access, flagging anomalous activity, supporting permissions remediation and stale-data cleanup.
Vulnerability management — scan configuration and scheduling, result validation, risk-based prioritization, and remediation tracking with system owners.

Monitor platform health, licensing, agent/sensor coverage gaps, and upgrade cycles.
Tune and maintain detection content in the organization's SIEM platform: refine correlation and detection rules, reduce false positives, and improve alert fidelity and context.
Onboard and validate new log sources; verify parsing, field normalization, and retention meet operational and compliance needs.
Build and maintain dashboards, saved searches, and reporting that give the team and leadership usable visibility.
Document detection logic, tuning rationale, and response guidance so alerts arrive with actionable next steps.
Administer and provide oversight for physical security systems, including badge and credential issuance, access group and door schedule configuration, card reader management, and video surveillance.
Conduct periodic access reviews for sensitive areas and coordinate timely revocation for departures and role changes.
Coordinate with facilities, HR, and vendors on installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and system expansion.
Retrieve and preserve access logs and video footage in support of investigations, following documented chain-of-custody practices.
Use AI assistants in daily security work — triage summarization, log and telemetry analysis, detection logic drafting, documentation, scripting, and research — while applying independent judgment to validate output before acting on it.
Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort in the security queue through AI-assisted workflows and automation, and help build them out.
Handle data responsibly in AI workflows: understand what may and may not be shared with which systems, and follow Safeguard's internal AI usage and data handling standards.
Contribute to securing the organization's own AI adoption — reviewing AI tools and integrations for security and data exposure risk, and helping shape practical guardrails for other teams.
Work with infrastructure, network, application, and support teams to verify that security standards, hardening baselines, and configuration requirements are applied and maintained.
Review proposed changes and new deployments for security impact, and provide practical guidance rather than blanket objections.
Support internal and external audit, assessment, and compliance activities by gathering evidence and documenting controls.
Contribute to security awareness efforts and help translate security requirements into terms other teams can act on.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Job Requirements:

[2–4] years of hands-on experience in information security, IT operations with security responsibilities, or a security operations center.
Working knowledge of core security concepts: common attack techniques, defense-in-depth, least privilege, and the incident response lifecycle.
Practical experience with at least two of the following categories: endpoint detection and response, secure web/network access enforcement, vulnerability management, data access monitoring, or SIEM/log analysis.
Solid foundation in networking (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, VPN, firewalls, proxies) and in Windows and Linux administration.
Experience with identity and access management concepts, including directory services, authentication, MFA, and access review processes.
Ability to write clearly and concisely — incident notes, procedures, and findings that others can follow.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage a queue of competing priorities without losing track of work.
Working knowledge of AI assistants in a professional setting with the judgment to know when to rely on their output and when to verify it independently.
Comfortable working directly with technical peers outside of security to reach a workable outcome.
Bachelor's degree in information security, computer science, information systems, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience administering physical access control and video surveillance platforms.
Experience writing or tuning detection rules and reducing alert noise in a SIEM.
Scripting or automation experience (PowerShell, Python) for reporting, enrichment, or repetitive task reduction.
Exposure to cloud environments (Azure, AWS) and cloud security controls.
Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, SOC 2, PCI DSS.
Relevant certifications: Security+, CySA+, GCIH, GSEC, SSCP, or vendor-specific platform certifications.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Third Party Risk
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) team is accountable for defining, maintaining, and overseeing the third-party risk framework, policy, and inventory in accordance with management expectations and best practices. We are focused on assessing and managing risks exposed through our relationships with third parties, adhering to regulatory guidance, and driving operational efficiencies across risk teams.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll support and maintain a robust framework for identifying, assessing, and managing third-party risks to protect Stripe. You'll partner with cross-functional Risk Domain Owners, Procurement subteams, Legal, and other stakeholders to apply a unified Third Party Risk Framework across risk and compliance areas. You'll maintain the existing Stripe Third Party Risk Program, Policy, and Standards, while further developing new Standards to propel the maturity of the Third Party Risk Program.

Responsibilities

Maintain the Global Third Party Risk Management Program, Policy, and Framework, ensuring alignment with relevant regulations, standards, and best practices
Launch and mature nascent risk domains to increase overall program maturity
Design and support an enhanced oversight model for specialized third-party types including Partnerships and Contingent Workers
Design and enhance elements of the existing Third Party Risk Framework including offboarding and incident monitoring, among other areas
Build and oversee the third-party performance management function and define performance standards, including metric templates and ongoing monitoring activities, to ensure third-party health
Design effective reporting to monitor and communicate the third-party risk program status, key issues, and remediation plans to governance committees, senior leaders, and relevant stakeholders
Serve as subject matter expert and coordinator of system business requirements among risk domain owners and stakeholders—prioritizing effective requirements (Users First and Risk Focused)

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

4+ years of experience in risk or compliance roles, preferably third-party risk in a regulated environment
Proven experience managing distinct projects and programs, with particularly strong skills in stakeholder management
Strong written and verbal communication skills—including the ability to communicate effectively with different stakeholders across the business such as risk domain owners, internal audit, and the broader risk and compliance community
Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, including navigating leadership and interpersonal working relationships
Strong organizational and time management skills
Ability to handle multiple assignments while comfortably managing ambiguity
Ability to assess and analyze data in order to solve problems and draw insightful conclusions

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience building third-party risk programs
Previous experience implementing programs around regulatory frameworks
Understanding of risk program elements including policy and risk appetite creation and maintenance
Understanding of risk areas such as information security, privacy, business continuity, finance, reputation, operational, and ESG
Experience with Tableau or other data visualization tools

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $123,600 - $185,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Summary

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will turn raw data into actionable insights to drive strategy by focusing on trends, creating dashboards, and optimizing business processes to improve customer relationship management.

Location of position:
GSA, Federal Acquisition Service, Office of Business Optimization

We are currently filling one vacancy, but additional vacancies may be filled as needed.

Learn more about this agency

Duties

The duty location will be determined at the time of selection in one of the following locations: Washington, DC; Kansas City, MO; Fort Worth, TX; Lakewood, CO; Tacoma, WA; Atlanta, GA; New York, NY; Boston, MA; San Francisco, CA; Philadelphia, PA; Chicago, IL; Norfolk, VA; Tampa, FL; Houston, TX; San Antonio, TX; and/or Orlando, FL.

The Office of Business Optimization, or Optimize, serves as the “dot connector” converting the Federal Acquisition Service vision into an operational reality to drive acquisition excellence. Our office is dedicated to enterprise-wide excellence in operations, proactive customer engagement, and cultivating a top-tier workforce.

Optimize is responsible for strategy development, procedure optimization, supply chain risk management, and data analytics to inform smart business decisions.

You will be responsible for the following duties
:

Turning raw data into actionable insights to drive strategy, focusing on trends, creating dashboards, and optimizing business processes to improve customer relationship management.
Leading the expansion of Customer Relationship Management System (CRM) and Cloud business intelligence (BI) capabilities through the use of acquisition data within the Federal Acquisition Service (FAS) organization providing documentation and supporting a continuous cycle for obtaining feedback for enhancements and application improvement.
Working with Federal Acquisition Service (FAS) business units and portfolios to define and document requirements; gathering, developing, and writing user stories that support business requirements; supporting and assisting with prioritization of tasks within the Change Control Board (CCB) and help maintain the requirements backlog for sprint releases.
Preparing and conducting briefings for higher level management to explain the impact of business decisions, providing recommendations, viable solutions, or action plans, and proposing guidance and direction for implementation of recommendations.
Creating, updating, and maintaining project documents including: business requirements, functional and non-functional requirements, functional design, data mapping, and report specifications.

Requirements

Conditions of employment

US Citizenship or National (Residents of American Samoa and Swains Island)
Meet all eligibility criteria within 30 days of the closing date
Meet time-in-grade within 30 days of the closing date, if applicable
Register with Selective Service if you are a male born after 12/31/1959
Direct Deposit of salary check to financial organization required.

If selected, you must meet the following conditions:

Current or Former Political Appointees: The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) must authorize employment offers made to current or former political appointees. If you are currently, or have been within the last 5 years, a political Schedule A, Schedule C or Non­Career SES employee in the Executive Branch, you must disclose this information to the HR Office. Failure to disclose this information could result in disciplinary action including removal from Federal Service.
Serve a one year probationary period, if required.
Undergo and pass a background investigation (Tier 2 investigation level).
Have your identity and work status eligibility verified if you are not a GSA employee. We will use the Department of Homeland Security’s e-Verify system for this. Any discrepancies must be resolved as a condition of continued employment.

Qualifications

To evaluate your qualifications, your resume must clearly demonstrate how you meet the specialized experience described below.
Your resume must not exceed two pages. To ensure your qualifications can be fully evaluated, we recommend including the following information:

Name, address, telephone number, email address;
Job Title (if Federal Service, provide series and grade; if not in GS plan, provide GS equivalent grade);
Relevant work experience—should include employer name, job title, start and end dates (month/year), the number of hours worked per week and descriptions that explain how you meet the required qualifications in the job announcement.
Education, certifications or licensures—If the job announcement requires any education, certifications or licensures, make sure to include the required information and any required documents like transcripts.

Your resume should contain enough information to make a valid determination that you fully meet experience requirements for each grade level you are applying to. If you do not provide enough information for us to determine your qualifications, you may be rated ineligible.

If you have volunteered your service through a National Service program (e.g., Peace Corps, Americorps), we encourage you to apply and include this experience on your resume.

The GS-13
salary range starts at $106,437.00
per year. If you are a new federal employee, your starting salary will likely be set at the Step 1 of the grade for which you are selected.

To qualify, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 level or higher in the Federal service.

Specialized experience
is experience optimizing business processes to improve customer relationship management and contract management. Such experience must include utilizing electronic-business, customer relationship management (CRM), and business intelligence (BI) systems:

Performing audits concerning contract and customer data management for organizational compliance;
Conducting analytical studies to benchmark metrics to identify performance gaps, establish realistic goals, and implement targeted improvements to drive business success;
Reviewing contract and customer data to ensure compliance with contractual terms; and
Compiling data to translate technical reports into presentations for customers and/or senior management.

Additional information

Candidates will not be hired based on their race, sex, color, religion, or national origin.

Applicants are encouraged to make their resume searchable in their USAJOBS.gov profile. This will allow Federal hiring specialists and hiring managers across agencies to find their resume as part of agency recruitment campaigns or staffing searches.

If you apply to this position and are selected, we will not ask about your criminal history before you receive a conditional job offer. If you believe you were asked about your criminal history improperly, contact the agency or visit GSA's webpage.

Relocation-related expenses are not approved and will be your responsibility.

On a case-by-case basis, the following incentives may be approved:

Recruitment incentive if you are new to the federal government
Relocation incentive if you are a current federal employee
Credit toward vacation leave if you are new to the federal government

Additional vacancies may be filled through this announcement in this or other GSA organizations within the same commuting area as needed; through other means; or not at all.

Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution.

A career with the U.S. government provides employees with a comprehensive benefits package. As a federal employee, you and your family will have access to a range of benefits that are designed to make your federal career very rewarding. Opens in a new windowLearn more about federal benefits.

You will have access to many benefits including:

Health insurance (choose from a wide range of plans)

Thrift Savings Plan (similar to a 401(k) plan)
Transit and child care subsidies
Flexible spending accounts
Long-term care insurance
Training and development

Position Overview

We are looking for a Tier 2 Cybersecurity Analyst to join Calian’s Cybersecurity team and support enterprise information security operations across organizational and technical domains. Reporting to the Cybersecurity Manager, this role will help maintain and enhance Calian’s corporate cybersecurity program while actively participating in security incident response, cyber investigations, threat hunting, anomaly detection, and preventative security measures.

The Tier 2 Cybersecurity Analyst will support Calian’s complex global environment, including on-premises infrastructure, hybrid cloud, and multi-cloud deployments. This position requires close collaboration with Cyber team members and partners across Information Systems and Development teams to help protect and support users across all Calian business units.

This position is open to candidates across Canada. Candidates based in the Ottawa region who are able to work in a hybrid capacity, with three days per week in our Kanata office, are preferred. Responsibilities

Investigate escalated incidents from Tier 1 analysts and the Security Operations Center, conduct root cause analysis, and determine appropriate containment and remediation actions.

Analyze threat intelligence and assess risks across logs, network traffic, and other data sources.

Identify, investigate, and respond to security threats, anomalies, and suspicious activity across enterprise environments.

Automate routine security processes to improve operational efficiency, including vulnerability scanning, threat detection workflows, and incident response activities.

Leverage AI and machine learning technologies to support threat detection and predictive security capabilities.

Deploy, manage, and maintain security controls, including endpoint protection, encryption technologies, and other cybersecurity solutions.

Produce detailed incident reports, document investigative activities, and provide recommendations for remediation and continuous improvement.

Support vulnerability management initiatives, security assessments, and risk reduction efforts.

Participate in ongoing training and professional development to stay current with emerging threats, technologies, and cybersecurity best practices.

Assist with annual reviews of security policies, procedures, and standards.

Collaborate with Cyber, Information Systems, and Development teams on operational security initiatives and projects.

Perform other duties as assigned in support of the cybersecurity operations program.

Qualifications

A post-secondary degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

Two to five years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, incident response, or related information security roles.

Demonstrated cybersecurity expertise through industry certifications, vendor certifications, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience responding to and investigating information security incidents.

Strong hands-on cybersecurity and information security experience.

Experience working in medium to large enterprise environments.

Experience with Endpoint Detection and Response and Extended Detection and Response platforms, including CrowdStrike.

Proficiency working with SIEM and EDR monitoring solutions.

Experience with vulnerability management systems and security operations processes.

Experience with cloud security environments including Azure, AWS, or GCP is considered an asset.

Strong understanding of security controls, risk assessment methodologies, and threat management techniques.

Solid understanding of ITIL principles and service management practices.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to build strong working relationships.

Strong problem-solving, analytical, and investigative abilities.

Ability to collaborate across teams and communicate technical concepts effectively.

Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.

Self-motivated with a proactive approach to learning, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.

Job Title: Information Security Analyst
(hybrid- onsite Monday- Thursday)

Location:
US-GA-Atlanta (Sandy Springs)

FLSA
: Exempt

Job Overview
:

Safeguard is seeking an Information Security Analyst to support the day-to-day operation and improvement of our security program. This is a hands-on, operationally focused role: you will triage and resolve security requests, serve as a first responder for potential security incidents, administer our physical access control and surveillance systems, and operate the platforms that protect our endpoints, network traffic, data, and infrastructure.

The role sits at the intersection of several teams. You will partner regularly with infrastructure, application, and end-user support groups to make sure security requirements are understood, implemented, and sustained — not just documented. Success in this position looks like fewer recurring issues, cleaner detection signal, faster response, and stronger working relationships with the teams whose systems you help secure.

Safeguard is an AI-first organization. We expect our security team to use AI assistants as part of their normal working rhythm: summarizing and correlating log data, drafting and refining detection logic, accelerating investigation write-ups, researching threats and techniques, and automating repetitive queue work. You do not need to be an AI specialist, but you should be genuinely comfortable working alongside these tools and interested in getting better at it.

Job Responsibilities:

Own an assigned queue of security requests, access reviews, escalations, and remediation tasks, driving each to documented completion within defined service levels.
Maintain clear, auditable records of actions taken, decisions made, and evidence collected.
Identify recurring ticket drivers and recommend automation, configuration changes, or process improvements to reduce them.
Serve as first-level responder for security alerts and reported events: validate, triage, contain where appropriate, and escalate to senior staff with a clear written handoff.
Perform initial investigation using endpoint, network, identity, and log telemetry to determine scope and impact.
Contribute to post-incident documentation, root cause analysis, and follow-up remediation tracking.
Participate in an on-call or after-hours escalation rotation as required.
Operate and maintain the organization's core security tooling, including:
